inputs_not_seen: No product description, intended names, source, stage packet, or design contract was read.

held_object.observation: A tabletop board-game set: a thick circular orange board with radial playing lanes, loose light and dark counters, two open cylindrical cups, and two pale cubes in front. No hand is visible, so handheld use and real size cannot be established.
held_object.evidence: The full isometric image shows the board and detached accessories together, with counters arranged in repeated rows on selected radial sectors.

volumetric_form.observation: The board is a low disk with a raised central circular platform and a scalloped perimeter of rounded protrusions. Narrow incised lines form many wedge-shaped lanes. Counters are flat extruded polygonal bodies with projecting ends: dark counters have paired prongs and light counters have a single tapered projection. Cups have thick visible walls and flat interior floors.
volumetric_form.evidence: Visible vertical side faces establish board, center, counter, and cup thickness; the paired panel close-up makes counter silhouettes and lane grooves clear.

subjects.observation: The main subjects are two opposing groups of stylized counters on a radial board. Dark silhouettes can read as little two-eared heads or fork-tailed objects; pale silhouettes resemble a polygonal bulb with a single neck or tail. I cannot identify a specific representational subject with confidence from these silhouettes alone.
subjects.evidence: Their top faces are plain and the recognition cues are restricted to the contrasting end projections.

action_change.observation: In the close-up, a pale counter moves from the upper-right lane to the lower-left lane occupied by a dark counter. That dark counter then appears on the raised central platform. The second dark counter near the lower edge and the five pale counters in the middle row remain in place.
action_change.evidence: BEFORE shows two pale counters in the upper lane and a dark counter at the lower-left edge; AFTER shows one pale counter in the upper lane, a pale counter replacing the lower-left dark one, and a dark counter newly visible at the center platform.

spatial_causal_relationship.observation: The before/after arrangement suggests a capturing or displacement move: one light piece lands on a dark piece's lane position and sends the dark piece to a central holding area. The radial grooves associate counters with separate lanes, and rows appear ordered from the outer edge toward the center.
spatial_causal_relationship.evidence: The exchanged position and newly occupied center occur together, while neighboring counters retain their positions. The picture establishes the state change but does not show a continuous motion path or determine movement rules.

distinctive_visual_identity.observation: The strongest identity is a golden sunburst-like circular game board with a scalloped edge, dense radial rays, a central hub, and contrasting pale and dark pronged counters. The two reddish cups and two cubes reinforce a traditional tabletop-game reading.
distinctive_visual_identity.evidence: The circular outline, warm color, radial incisions, raised hub, paired cups, and detached cubes are all visible in the full view.

visible_defects_or_ambiguities.observation: The representational identities of the two counter types are ambiguous; the end shapes distinguish sides more readily than they convey a specific theme.
visible_defects_or_ambiguities.evidence: Plain polygonal bodies and small prongs are the only subject cues.

visible_defects_or_ambiguities.observation: The cubes' visible faces appear blank, so their intended use as dice or scoring objects cannot be read visually.
visible_defects_or_ambiguities.evidence: The isometric view shows unmarked cream top and side faces on both cubes.

visible_defects_or_ambiguities.observation: Some counters sit extremely close to the outer rim or over a lane's rounded end, which leaves finger clearance and secure placement uncertain.
visible_defects_or_ambiguities.evidence: The bottom dark counters in the close-up align with or nearly overhang the outer vertical board face; the long pale row reaches the scalloped perimeter.

visible_defects_or_ambiguities.observation: The movement mechanism is manual repositioning as far as the images reveal; no linkage, captive track, hinge, or other moving mechanism is visible.
visible_defects_or_ambiguities.evidence: Pieces rest separately on uninterrupted board surfaces, and the two panels depict discrete states.

visible_defects_or_ambiguities.observation: Several fine grooves appear discontinuous or dotted in the full render; this may be a rendering artifact rather than broken geometry.
visible_defects_or_ambiguities.evidence: Near-vertical lane lines toward the upper and lower center intermittently disappear at this image scale.

gross_visible_geometry_defects: No obvious floating major assembly, unintended large overlap, or missing section of the board is visible in these two images.
limitations: Visual inspection only; dimensions, underside details, printability, legal moves, and physical fit are not established.
